coords: Babylon world XZ metres, y = 0 support (y_offset only for floating/stacked items)

collider_classes.soft: client-only avoidance; never a server collider
collider_classes.solid: server collider request: circle r = footprint_r (codex-requests R-COL-1)

masks.meadow: open land outside the other masks
masks.shore: within 3 m of any water edge
masks.feature: walk plazas and feature areas (curated, low density)

exclusions: monster homes 1.6 m and patrols 1.2 m (soft/solid)

budget.basis: 120k layout budget - terrain spec 7.4 maxima (ground 12k + hills 8k + rock 16k + decals 4k) - feature hero props ~25k - water ~5k = ~55k; dressing <= 40k keeps ~15k slack
